comment: Client ground-truth page-type labels -> our v29.2 paths (L1 > L2 > L3). Key = the GT label lower-cased with everything but letters and digits removed. Our path is L1 > L2 > L3 (Others dropped). FULL (1): a 'full' target is a prefix of our path. PARTIAL (0.5): a 'partial' target is a prefix of our path, or our L1 is the L1 of a 'full' target (our path stops above the GT level, a sibling L3, or another L2 under the same L1). MISS (0) otherwise. 'exclude' labels (cover / index / fax / blank pages, NA, Misc ...) are not page types and are not scored. A page scores the better of Extracted and Final. Built by training/taxonomy/build_gt_mapping.py from GT_mapping_v29_2.xlsx; docs/gt_page_type_mapping.csv is the same mapping as a table.
